hostPolicy.value: loopback only (localhost, 127.0.0.0/8, ::1); others only via endpoint.configureEndpointPolicy({allowHosts}) by the hosting process

defaultProfileDir.value: <googleSupportDir()>/Chrome-CDP (directory is created with mkdir -p on launch)

stateDir.mode: 0700, owned by uid; unsafe/uncreatable dir yields degraded mode, not a throw

storageReaders.layout: <profileDir>/Default/{History,Cookies,Bookmarks}; profileDir defaults to chromeProfileDir() (the dedicated CDP profile, never the everyday profile)
storageReaders.openMode: mode=ro&immutable=1 (no locks, ignores WAL: rows not yet checkpointed are invisible)

chromeBinary.linux: first of `which google-chrome`, `which chromium`, `which chromium-browser`; '' when none

processProbe.value: lsof -ti tcp:<port> -sTCP:LISTEN, fallback fuser <port>/tcp, ps -o command=/pgid=: POSIX only; no Windows implementation (probe answers empty/null on failure)

killPath.value: process.kill(-pid) process group then pid, SIGTERM: POSIX semantics; no taskkill path

userDataPaths.value: all three OS branches exist in googleSupportDir/defaultChromeDir

posixAssumption.value: checkChromeActivity derives meta.profileDir with history.path.replace('/Default/History','') - a forward-slash assumption that would not strip on Windows

stateDirTmp.value: os.tmpdir()-based; uid via process.getuid (0 on Windows)

platform.verifiedPlatform: No spec runs on a real non-macOS host; specs inject platform where needed and never start Chrome (AGENTS.md). Cross-platform claims are code-path existence only.
